name: io.github.marcpineault/glacier-planner-calculator
title: Glacier Planner: Free Canadian Retirement Calculator
description: Free Canadian retirement projections and one what-if from confirmed inputs. No Glacier account.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: No authentication, Glacier account, API key or payment required for an available basic calculation. Host requirements and public request limits apply.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.scope: Supplied basic inputs and one explicit retirement-age, spending or CPP/QPP/OAS start-age alternative. Explicit confirmation of assumptions and any compared benefit ages required. No private saved-plan access, account writes, advanced analyses or reports.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.financialData: The public calculator does not persist financial inputs/results. Caller-held artifacts and AI conversations can retain them.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.advice: Projections and education, not personalized investment advice.
